stories.headline: Amazon's Q2 Beats as AWS Growth Hits 37%, Its Fastest in 18 Quarters
stories.key_takeaway: AWS reaccelerated to 37% growth, its fastest in 18 quarters, signaling that AI infrastructure spending has become durable, capacity-constrained cloud revenue even as Amazon lifts 2026 capex to about $220 billion.

pull_quote.text: AWS is booming, growing 36.7% year-over-year in Q2 - our fastest growth in 18 quarters - and our AI and Chips businesses each eclipsed run rates of more than $25 billion

stories.article_excerpt: Amazon delivered the quarter Wall Street had been waiting more than four years for: its cloud engine roared back to life.

stories.headline: Rhoda AI Emerges From Stealth With $450 Million to Give Robots 'FutureVision' Control
stories.key_takeaway: Rhoda AI exited stealth with a $450M Series A at a $1.7B valuation to commercialize FutureVision, a video-predictive robot foundation model that trains on internet-scale video to work reliably outside the lab.

pull_quote.text: We believe the next era of robotics requires models that understand how the world moves - not just what it looks like or how it's described in language.

stories.article_excerpt: Rhoda AI exited stealth with a $450M Series A led by Premji Invest, unveiling its FutureVision robot foundation model.

stories.headline: AMD and Cerebras Team Up on Disaggregated AI Inference to Slash Latency
stories.key_takeaway: AMD and Cerebras unveiled a disaggregated AI inference platform pairing AMD Helios GPUs for prompt processing with the Cerebras Wafer-Scale Engine for ultra-low-latency token generation, claiming up to 5x higher tokens per second per watt.

pull_quote.text: AI inference is becoming one of the largest infrastructure opportunities in AI, and its growing diversity requires a more flexible approach.

stories.article_excerpt: AMD and Cerebras stitch two rival chip architectures into one disaggregated inference pipeline, claiming 5x better tokens-per-watt.

stories.headline: Baselayer Raises $20 Million to Automate Fraud and Risk Checks for Banks
stories.key_takeaway: Baselayer raised a $20M Series A led by Koro Capital and M13 to scale its AI platform that automates business risk assessment and fraud detection for banks and government agencies, bringing total funding to about $47M.

pull_quote.text: Working with Baselayer has been a game changer for us. Baselayer helps us accurately verify business applicants and get new Rho customers up and running significantly faster, while also supporting the integrity of our world-class compliance operations.

stories.article_excerpt: Baselayer raised $20M in Series A funding led by Koro Capital and M13 to automate fraud and risk checks for banks.

stories.headline: Dutch Insurer Unive Rolls Out ChatGPT Enterprise, and Staff Build 1,500 Custom GPTs
stories.key_takeaway: Dutch cooperative insurer Unive deployed ChatGPT Enterprise workforce-wide, and its employees built roughly 1,500 custom GPTs that cut claims and underwriting prep from hours to minutes while humans keep final decision authority.

pull_quote.text: Most organisations try to scale AI by building more solutions. We chose to scale AI by creating more builders.

stories.article_excerpt: Unive rolled out ChatGPT Enterprise workforce-wide, and staff built ~1,500 custom GPTs that cut claims prep from hours to minutes.

stories.headline: Microsoft Quietly Previews MAI-Realtime, Its First Full-Duplex Voice Model
stories.key_takeaway: Microsoft has quietly surfaced MAI-Realtime, its first native full-duplex speech-to-speech model, in a hidden MAI Playground preview, signaling a serious first-party push into the voice-AI race and further reduced dependence on OpenAI.

pull_quote.text: This is all about long term self-sufficiency for Microsoft and our partners. It's about models you can trust.

stories.article_excerpt: MAI-Realtime, Microsoft's first native full-duplex voice model, surfaced unannounced in a hidden MAI Playground preview.

stories.headline: Alibaba Unveils Qwen3.8-Max, a 2.4-Trillion-Parameter Bid for the Model Crown
stories.key_takeaway: Alibaba's 2.4-trillion-parameter Qwen3.8-Max, a sparse MoE model launching API-first with open weights promised next week, is China's latest bid for the frontier crown against Moonshot's Kimi K3.

pull_quote.text: Alibaba is narrowing the gap, but the larger story is the rapid maturation of open-weight models. Enterprises increasingly have credible alternatives to proprietary frontier models, where openness often matters as much as absolute model performance.

stories.article_excerpt: Alibaba's 2.4-trillion-parameter Qwen3.8-Max lands API-first, open weights promised next week, in China's frontier model race.

stories.headline: OpenAI Swaps In GPT-5.5 Instant Mini as ChatGPT's New Fallback Model
stories.key_takeaway: OpenAI has replaced GPT-5.3 Instant Mini with a GPT-5.5-generation fallback model in ChatGPT, an incremental quality bump to the tier users hit after exhausting rate limits.

pull_quote.text: GPT-5.5 Instant Mini better tracks evolving user intent, calibrates tone, and avoids repetitive or overly structured responses.

stories.article_excerpt: OpenAI has quietly upgraded the model most ChatGPT users never choose but many eventually meet: the fallback tier.

stories.headline: Moonshot Sets an August 31 Sunset for Kimi-K2.5 and Its moonshot-v1 APIs
stories.key_takeaway: Moonshot AI will fully retire kimi-k2.5 and its entire moonshot-v1 API series on August 31, 2026, giving developers roughly 28 days to migrate to Kimi K3, K2.6, or K2.7 Code.

pull_quote.text: Kimi K3's weights are downloadable under Moonshot's own licence, so a company or government can run it on its own hardware, keep its data in-house, and modify it.

stories.article_excerpt: Moonshot AI confirms kimi-k2.5 and its moonshot-v1 API series retire Aug 31, 2026, pushing developers toward Kimi K3.

stories.headline: AI Models Now Beat Experts on Hard Biology Benchmarks, Reviving Dual-Use Fears
stories.key_takeaway: Frontier AI models now match or beat PhD experts on hard biology and virology benchmarks, prompting labs and policymakers to tighten biosecurity safeguards over dual-use fears.

pull_quote.text: This is very worrying to me, because throughout history there have been a fair number of cases where an attempt to make a bioweapon failed, and one of the biggest reasons why is that they didn't have access to the right expertise.

stories.article_excerpt: Frontier AI now outscores PhD experts on hard biology and virology benchmarks, reviving dual-use biosecurity fears.

stories.headline: Researchers Push for Explainable Protein-Design AI to Crack Open the Black Box
stories.key_takeaway: CRG researchers published the most comprehensive survey yet of explainable AI for protein language models, offering a roadmap and interpretability toolkit to make these black-box biology tools transparent, trustworthy and safe.

pull_quote.text: Without better ways to explain what these models learn and how they make decisions, we risk building powerful tools that we cannot fully trust.
pull_quote.role: Group Leader, Centre for Genomic Regulation

stories.article_excerpt: The AI models that let scientists dream up enzymes never seen in nature are also among the least understood tools in modern biology.

stories.headline: 'Agent-Diff' Benchmark Tests Whether AI Agents Can Really Handle Enterprise APIs
stories.key_takeaway: Agent-Diff grades AI agents on whether enterprise software actually ended up in the correct state rather than on their final text, and even the best model fully completed only 76% of 224 tasks.

pull_quote.text: Rather than fuzzy trace or parameter matching, we compute the state difference between sandbox snapshots and define task success by whether the expected change in environment state was achieved.

stories.article_excerpt: A new Minerva benchmark evaluates 9 LLMs on 224 enterprise tasks by checking whether system state actually changed correctly.

stories.headline: AI-Run 'Self-Driving Labs' Are Automating Protein and Enzyme Discovery
stories.key_takeaway: AI-powered biofoundries that close the design-build-test-learn loop with robotics are now autonomously engineering enzymes, improving activity many-fold in weeks and moving from academic demos toward commercial autonomous science.

pull_quote.text: Enzymes have been increasingly used in energy production, in therapeutics, even in consumer products like laundry detergent. But they are not as widely used as they could be, because they still have limitations. Our technology can help address those limitations efficiently.
pull_quote.role: Professor of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering, UIUC

stories.article_excerpt: A new class of 'self-driving labs' couples ML design with robotic build-test hardware to autonomously engineer proteins and enzymes.

stories.headline: Senators Introduce Bipartisan Bill Giving Parents Control Over Kids' AI Chatbots
stories.key_takeaway: A bipartisan quartet of senators introduced the CHATBOT Act, which would force AI companies to build parent-controlled 'family accounts' giving parents consent, monitoring, and transcript access over how their children use AI chatbots.

pull_quote.text: We've seen reports of AI chatbots encouraging kids to hurt themselves and for some, they're replacing real life relationships, isolating kids from their families and friends. Our bill will give parents better tools to keep their kids safe and hold AI companies accountable.

stories.article_excerpt: A bipartisan quartet of senators wants to hand parents the keys to their children's AI chatbot accounts via the CHATBOT Act.

stories.headline: California Lawmakers Return to a Pile of AI Bills as the Session Resumes
stories.key_takeaway: California's legislature reconvened August 3 to decide the fate of roughly 30 AI bills in back-to-back appropriations hearings, cementing the state's role as the nation's de facto AI regulator amid a federal preemption push.

pull_quote.text: When a conversation between children and a chatbot goes wrong, the consequences can be dire. We have seen the consequences of our inaction towards the dangers posed by social media, and the stakes are too high to make the same mistakes again.

stories.article_excerpt: California legislators returned August 3 to decide which of roughly 30 pending AI bills survive back-to-back appropriations hearings.

stories.headline: Washington's Push to Preempt State AI Laws Heads for a Court Fight
stories.key_takeaway: Trump's December 2025 executive order to preempt state AI laws through DOJ litigation and federal funding conditions is now being tested in court, most directly in the xAI-DOJ challenge to Colorado's AI Act.

pull_quote.text: States, with our flexibility and responsiveness to the market, changing technology, and the needs of our residents, are on the front lines of consumer protection, including when it comes to emerging technology. We take this job seriously.

stories.article_excerpt: Trump's Executive Order 14365 set the federal government on a collision course with the states over who governs AI.
